description: This circular chart visually represents nine distinct capabilities, each assigned a numerical value indicating the number of samples within that category, with the total spanning 1.1K samples across three levels of difficulty as noted in the paper. The chart is divided into nine colored segments, each labeled with its corresponding capability and sample count: “Prioritization” (100, light red), “Personalization” (100, coral red), “Privacy Protection” (111, dark red), “Multitasking” (160, teal green), “Contradiction Resolution” (central, brown), “Context Tracking” (central, dark blue), “Context Retrieving” (central, dark green), “Recursive Reasoning” (110, bright blue), “Dynamic Environment” (100, navy blue), “Memorization” (100, cyan), and “Dynamic Instruction” (100, light cyan). The central ring contains three labeled segments in white text: “Contradiction Resolution,” “Context Tracking,” and “Context Retrieving.” The outer ring is divided into six segments, each with a distinct color and labeled with its capability name and numerical value. The chart does not include a legend, but the labels are directly connected to their respective segments via thin blue lines. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, with “Multitasking” (160) appearing as the largest segment, followed by “Privacy Protection” (111), “Recursive Reasoning” (110), and the remaining categories are either 100 or have smaller proportions. The chart does not use exploded slices or bolded text to emphasize any particular segment.
